lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Combine 'Nia packed the lunch' and 'the group left early' using and, then express a reason using because.

FEEDBACK
Compound: 'Nia packed the lunch, and the group left early.' Complex: 'The group left early because the weather was changing.' The new reason is one possible completion.

CHECK
Joining any two fragments with and does not automatically create two independent clauses.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Write three compound and three complex sentences about an outdoor activity. Mark independent clauses, circle conjunctions, and explain why the because- or although-clause cannot stand alone.

Write a short reflection describing one specific revision you made and why.
